unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 6 - Fractions, Decimals and Percentages - Year 5-6 Maths.pptx
anchor: one amount, three names: fraction, decimal, percentage; make it out of 100 to switch

lessons.focus: Fractions to decimals with tenths, hundredths and thousandths. Critical feature: make the denominator 10, 100 or 1000, then read the decimal. Review: area and perimeter (Week 5), probability (Week 4).

A fraction is a division: numerator divided by denominator with the division bracket; decimals back to simplified fractions. Critical feature: 3/8 means 3 divided by 8. Review: probability, area and perimeter.
Percentages as fractions and decimals on a hundred grid. Critical feature: per cent means out of 100. Review: probability, grid coordinates, area.

Compare and order fractions, decimals and percentages by converting to one form and using a number line. Critical feature: convert to the same form first. Review: coordinates, the Cartesian plane, probability.

Percentage of an amount with benchmark strategies (50%, 25%, 10%, 1%) and multiplication and division. Critical feature: find a benchmark, then build. Review: the Cartesian plane, coordinates, area and perimeter.
